aviation_incidents.headline: 歐洲航空安全總署縮短ATR 42與ATR 72除冰系統閥門檢查間隔 防範結冰時失控
aviation_incidents.summary: 歐洲航空安全總署要求ATR 42與ATR 72營運商依機型及改裝情況，每160、190或210飛行小時檢查除冰系統閥門；檢查未通過須在再次飛行前排除故障。指令於2026年11月30日生效，以降低結冰時失控的風險。巴西調查人員認定，結冰及多重除冰系統失效是2024年8月9日沃帕斯航空2283號班機墜毀的肇因之一，機上62人全數罹難。
aviation_incidents.headline_en: European regulator EASA orders more frequent ATR 42 and ATR 72 de-icing valve checks to reduce loss-of-control risk
aviation_incidents.summary_en: The European Union Aviation Safety Agency has ordered ATR 42 and ATR 72 operators to inspect de-icing system valves every 160, 190 or 210 flight hours, depending on the model and modifications. Faults found in a check must be corrected before the next flight. The directive takes effect on November 30, 2026, to reduce the risk of loss of control in icing. Brazilian investigators identified icing and multiple de-icing system failures among the factors in the August 9, 2024, crash of Voepass Flight 2283, which killed all 62 aboard.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 星宇航空規劃2027年3月開航臺北－雪梨－奧克蘭 航網可望首度延伸至大洋洲
taiwan_aviation.summary: 星宇航空規劃2027年3月23日以A330-900開航臺北－雪梨－奧克蘭，初期每週4班，5月1日起擬增為每日1班，航網可望首度延伸至大洋洲。星宇也將與澳洲航空合作拓展聯程航網，預計2027年底前機隊增至48架。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: STARLUX Airlines plans Taipei–Sydney–Auckland service for March 2027, its first route into Oceania
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: STARLUX Airlines plans to launch Taipei–Sydney–Auckland service on March 23, 2027, using A330-900 aircraft. It plans four weekly flights initially and daily service from May 1. The route would extend its network into Oceania for the first time. STARLUX also plans to expand connecting options through cooperation with Qantas and expects its fleet to reach 48 aircraft by the end of 2027.

international_aviation.headline: 美國空軍首批常駐海外F-15EX戰機抵日本嘉手納 推進F-15C／D機隊換裝
international_aviation.summary: 美國空軍首批永久配置海外的F-15EX戰機於2026年11月15日抵達沖繩嘉手納空軍基地，由第67戰鬥機中隊接收，是美國空軍首次在海外部署具作戰編制的F-15EX。嘉手納原有F-15C／D自2022年11月起分階段撤離，期間由戰機輪調維持戰備；新機仍須配合人員訓練及維修整備，逐步形成完整戰力。
international_aviation.headline_en: First US Air Force F-15EX fighters permanently based overseas arrive at Kadena in Japan, advancing F-15C/D replacement
international_aviation.summary_en: The first US Air Force F-15EX Eagle II fighters permanently assigned overseas arrived at Kadena Air Base in Okinawa on November 15, 2026, and were received by the 67th Fighter Squadron. It is the Air Force's first overseas deployment of combat-coded F-15EX fighters. Kadena's F-15C/D fleet began a phased withdrawal in November 2022, with rotational fighters maintaining readiness during the transition. Personnel training and maintenance are still needed to build full capability.

international_aviation.headline: 航空短訊：Azul Conecta啟用SkyCourier載運亞馬遜油田工人 英國法院下令強制清算Global Airlines 中國商飛CE-25A電動飛機完成首次載人試飛
international_aviation.summary: Azul Conecta首架19座SkyCourier於11月3日投入服務，為巴西石油公司載運亞馬遜油田工人；往返瑪瑙斯的每週航班也開放一般旅客購票。英國法院11月4日下令強制清算Global Airlines，12日公告；該公司曾執行4個載客航段，唯一的A380仍停放法國。中國商飛電動飛機CE-25A於11月14日在山東濱州完成首次載人試飛，機上有2名飛行員及1名試飛工程師，先前已完成19次無人驗證飛行。
international_aviation.headline_en: Aviation briefs: Azul Conecta starts SkyCourier flights for Amazon oil crews, UK court orders Global Airlines into compulsory liquidation, COMAC CE-25A makes first piloted test flight
international_aviation.summary_en: Azul Conecta's first 19-seat Cessna SkyCourier entered service on November 3, carrying Petrobras oil crews in the Amazon; its weekly Manaus flights also sell seats to the public. A UK court ordered Global Airlines into compulsory liquidation on November 4, and the order was published on November 12. The company had operated four passenger flight legs, and its sole A380 remains stored in France. COMAC's electric CE-25A completed its first piloted test flight in Binzhou, Shandong, on November 14, with two pilots and a flight-test engineer aboard, following 19 uncrewed validation flights.

international_aviation.headline: 聯合航空系統故障導致全美主線航班暫停出發 故障排除後航班恢復出發
international_aviation.summary: 聯合航空11月16日晚間系統故障，無法計算飛機重量與平衡，導致全美主線出發航班暫停，數千名旅客行程延誤。故障已排除，航班恢復出發，但當晚仍可能出現延誤；已在空中的航班及聯合快運不受影響。聯合航空表示，沒有跡象顯示故障與網路安全有關。
international_aviation.headline_en: United Airlines flights resume after system outage halts US mainline departures
international_aviation.summary_en: United Airlines suffered a system outage on the evening of November 16 that prevented it from calculating aircraft weight and balance, halting US mainline departures and delaying thousands of passengers. The issue has been resolved and departures have resumed, though further delays were possible that evening. Airborne flights and United Express services were unaffected. United said there was no indication of a cybersecurity connection.
